title: SWF: infinite-loop sound (repeatCount=0) writes LoopCount=0, sound never plays
description: In packages/swf/src/sounds.ts lines 156-157, bw.writeUI16LE(opts.loops!) writes 0 when opts.loops===0 (infinite repeat). Ruffle's mixer treats num_loops=0 as 'don't play'. Fix: write 0xFFFF when opts.loops===0 to indicate infinite loops, matching SWF spec §Sound.
